name: 10. Email Enquiry Lead - Discord to Wrapp v1

parameters.content:
## Email Enquiry Lead — Multi-source

5 Discord lead channels, each tagged with its lead type, into one shared pipeline.

Flow:
1. Schedule Trigger fires every minute
2. 5 Discord nodes fetch latest 20 messages from each channel (parallel)
3. Each Discord output passes through a `Tag: <Lead Type>` Set node that adds `leadType` + `leadSourceChannel`
4. All 5 Tag outputs converge into `Remove Duplicates` (dedupe by Discord message ID)
5. Loop Over Items → Normalize Discord Message (preserves `leadType`)
6. Parse Lead From Discord Text + Explode imageAttachments (parallel)
7. OpenAI infers state/postcode from suburb → Merge with parsed lead
8. Sanitize + Fingerprint Lead → Remove Duplicate Leads (dedupe by `leadFingerprint`)
9. Discord 👍 react + Wrapp Create Opportunity + Wait 5s → Google Sheets + Discord confirmation
10. Drive upload for image attachments runs in parallel

Channel → Lead Type map:
- email-enquiry-lead         → Email Enquiry Lead
- email-workorder-lead       → Email Workorder Lead
- email-property-agent-lead  → Email Property Agent Lead
- body-corp-email-lead       → Body Corp Email Lead
- body-corp-inbound-lead     → Body Corp Inbound Lead

Rules:
- Check n8n templates first
- Prefer `WR:` credentials
- Use native nodes first; HTTP only when no native node exists
- Update sticky notes after any change
- Test changed nodes one by one then full E2E

Pending:
- Per-lead-type Google Sheet (new sheet, TBD ID) for per-type tab logging
- Wrapp photo upload branch placeholder (after Drive upload)
- PDF support in attachments (currently images only)

## Setup / TODO

1. Finalize Wrapp photos API branch
2. Re-enable Gmail error alert after creating gmailOAuth2 credential
3. Verify Discord channel IDs and Google folder/sheet IDs in production
4. Tune fingerprint rules if dedupe is too strict or too loose
5. Record every live node-by-node + E2E test in `notes.md`
6. Review AI suburb to postcode accuracy on a few sample suburbs

Current enquiry format:
- Workorder#
- Job Details
- Tenant
- Invoicing Details
